item.description: David D'Angelo, programmer at Yacht Club Games: Mina actually started with, Alec, the director, as a side project. He wanted to get better at doing art stuff. He said, “I'm gonna make a little game where I could make Game Boy Color art.

item.title: Google Is Quietly Hiding A New Zelda: Ocarina of Time Easter Egg
item.description: The official release of the Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is only a couple of days away, but search engine Google has already started the festivities with a clever nod to Nintendo's landmark adventure game.

item.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Studio Officially Revealed
item.description: Nintendo is infamously cagey about revealing which studios are working on its games. While the company’s secrecy isn’t entirely out of step with an industry that generally hides how the sausage is made, Nintendo takes this to another level, trying to create a Disneyland-like sense of wonder around its brand.

item.title: FF14’s New Expansion Officially Addresses Dawntrail’s Biggest Problem
item.description: None of Final Fantasy 14 's expansions so far are overtly awful, but there are some that don't quite hit the highs of others. That was the case for 2024's Dawntrail expansion, which had the unenviable task of being the first part of the MMORPG's new arc. One major criticism from players fell on the story's pacing, which could admittedly be all over the place. For Evercold , the next expansion, Square Enix is making it a point to fix this.

item.title: Dune Officially Returns With New Release This Week Ahead of Denis Villeneuve's Next Movie
item.description: Denis Villeneuve’s Dune: Part Three releases on Dec. 18, and trailers have shown he’s making some big changes to the source material . Villeneuve divided Frank Herbert’s 1965 masterpiece into two films, and is ending his trilogy by adapting Herbert’s 1969 sequel Dune Messiah . If you’re curious about the changes, a new way to experience the original story is coming on Nov. 3.

item.title: FBI Issues Surprise Official 'Pokémon' Trading Card Warning
item.description: There's big money involved in selling Pokémon cards, so it was only a matter of time before the Federal Bureau of Investigation became a real player on the scene. A few weeks after the announcement of an official investigation into the biggest Pokémon card heist ever recorded, the Department of Justice is back with a new warning for people who participate in the popular TCG hobby.

item.title: Critical Role Just Made One of D&D’s Most Popular Classes Even More Broken
item.description: For as long as Critical Role has existed, the cast and crew have made it clear to Critters that they are open to bending or straight-up changing the rules of Dungeons & Dragons to fit the story they want to tell. For example, Matthew Mercer has created classes like the Blood Hunter and added subclasses to better fit the stories his players are telling together.

item.title: The Pokémon Company Is Counting Down to a Surprise Reveal This Month
item.description: The Pokémon Company has been celebrating the franchise's 30th anniversary throughout 2026. Part of that celebration included making Poké Ball-themed logos for every single Pokémon — over 1,000 in total. Now, The Pokémon Company is using those logos to seemingly tease a surprise reveal at the end of the month.

item.title: Ahsoka Cast Drops Big Hints About Season 2
item.description: The cast of Ahsoka season 2 had plenty to say about the upcoming Star Wars series over the weekend. During a panel at Los Angeles Comic-Con, Rosario Dawson, Natasha Liu Bordizzo, and Eman Esfandi — who play Ahsoka, Sabine, and Ezra, respectively — dropped hints about what to expect when the show returns to Disney Plus on January 20, 2027. As per Star Wars News Net , the entirety of the panel was unofficially uploaded to YouTube .

item.title: Genshin Impact version 7.2 release time in your time zone
item.description: Genshin Impact 's 7.2 patch is coming soon, expanding the story in Snezhnaya, adding more characters to the playable roster, and running a slew of limited-time events to bide your time.
